content:
The issue is that RH (per archiving story 2323911) is sending **‘REPL’** instead of **‘NEWM’** to TRAX for replayed messages on **active trades** (i.e., trades not archived in CMRS). This is impacting the **#13** fix.

The new **#13** ESP extract is sending replay messages for rebooked trades, updated with the original Position Trader information based on OMS trade linkages. However, because these messages are flagged as replay (**<SST_REPLAY> = ‘Y’**), RH reports them to TRAX as **‘REPL’**. TRAX then rejects them because the trades have never previously been reported to TRAX (so TRAX expects **‘NEWM’**, not **‘REPL’**).

As a result, all **#13** replay messages will be rejected by TRAX, just like other BAU replay messages, meaning the **#13** changes in ESP and RH will have no effect.
